name: create-story
description: Write long-form fiction whose paragraphs connect. A story bible, a beat sheet and a per-scene exit state carry the story between scenes; a script assembles the drafter's whole context (bible sections, entry state, beat card, the last two paragraphs) so the window cannot widen; a transition audit fails a scene with an orphan paragraph; and a fresh-context critic reads what the drafter cannot. Built from three deep-research reports on why models keep the plot and lose the thread.
